requirement: Every privileged action must have a documented threat model
Secret fields must never be spoken or remotely mirrored in plaintext
Security prompts must be distinguishable from ordinary application prompts
Loss of network must not remove local recovery
Sensitive accessibility text must be redacted from logs
Privileged approvals must require explicit authorization
Security events must produce structured bounded evidence
Updates must be authenticated and rollback-safe
accessibility_property: accessible update status and rollback reason

requirement: Keys must be separated by purpose and never hardcoded
Security failures must be deterministic and explicit
Remote accessibility channels must be authenticated and encrypted
accessibility_property: semantic remote access without secret leakage

requirement: Third-party GitHub Actions must be pinned to full commit SHA
accessibility_property: CI failures must expose plain-text diagnostics
